headline: Recommended six budget resolutions, including $1,630,167.75 for Amoskeag EB and canal ramp work, and approved twelve budget authorizations.
summary: Other resolutions add $15,833 for FY25 hazmat training and $30,000 for a domestic violence prosecutor. The budget authorizations are approved subject to final adoption of the related resolutions.
decisions: Voted that six budget resolutions ought to pass and be enrolled.
Approved twelve budget authorizations, subject to final adoption of related resolutions.

decision_titles: Six resolutions amending the Community Improvement Program
transcript:
## COMMITTEE ON FINANCE

October 20, 2026 Upon Recess of the BMA

Mayor Ruais called the meeting to order.

The Clerk called the roll.

Present: Aldermen Kaw-uh, Goonan, Dexter, Fajardo, Bonilla, Kantor, Trisciani, O’ Neil, Terrio, Sapienza, Burkush, Barry, Vincent

Absent: Alderman Thomas

1. Resolutions:

“Amending the FY2023 Community Improvement Program, authorizing, appropriating and transferring funds in the amount of One Million Six Hundred Thirty Thousand One Hundred Sixty-Seven Dollars and Seventy-Five Cents ($1,630,167.75) for the FY2023 CIP 711323Amoskeag EB & Canal Ramp Design and Construction.”

“Amending the FY2027 Community Improvement Program, authorizing and appropriating funds in the amount of Fifteen Thousand Eight Hundred Thirty- Three Dollars ($15,833) for the FY2027 CIP C300040727 FY25 Hazmat Training.”

“Amending the FY2022 and FY2027 Community Improvement Program, authorizing, appropriating and transferring funds in the amount of Ten Thousand Dollars ($10,000) for the FY2027 CIP C410020327 Community Health Workers CRU Funding.”

“Amending the FY2027 Community Improvement Program, authorizing and appropriating funds in the amount of Twenty Thousand Four Hundred Forty-Five Dollars ($20,445) for the FY2027 CIP C500070527 FY27 Household Hazardous Waste Collection.”

“Amending the FY2022 and FY2024 Community Improvement Program, authorizing, appropriating and transferring funds in the amount of Sixty-Three Thousand Seven Hundred Fifty Three Dollars and Twelve Cents ($63,753.12) for the FY2022 CIP 712622 ARPA - Revenue Replacement - Roads and Sidewalks and FY2024 CIP 810724 Part Time Planner”

“Amending the FY2027 Community Improvement Program, authorizing and appropriating funds in the amount of Thirty Thousand Dollars ($30,000) for the FY2027 CIP C070040127 Domestic Violence Prosecutor.”

On motion of Alderman Kaw-uh , duly seconded by Alderman Fajardo , it was voted to waive the reading by titles only.

October 20, 2026 COMMITTEE ON FINANCE

On motion of Alderman O’ Neil , duly seconded by Alderman Dexter , it was voted that the Resolutions ought to pass and be Enrolled.

2. Budget Authorizations:

• 212322 ARPA - Community Health Worker Program

• 711323 Amoskeag EB & Canal Ramp Design & Construction

• 712523 Bridge Inspection, Repair & Rehabilitation

• C300040727 FY25 Hazmat Training

• C410020327 Community Health Workers CRU Funding

• C500070527 FY27 Household Hazardous Waste Collection

• 212222 ARPA – Healthy Corner Stores Project

• 410222 ARPA – ACERT Program

• 712622 ARPA – Revenue Replacement – Roads & Sidewalks

• 810724 Part Time Planner

• 810822 ARPA – Small Business Grants & Program Assistance

• C070040127 Domestic Violence Prosecutor

On motion of Alderman Burkush , duly seconded by Alderman Barry , it was voted that the Budget Authorizations be approved subject to final adoption of related Resolutions.

There being no further business, on motion of Alderman Sapienza , duly seconded by

Alderman Trisciani , it was voted to adjourn.

A True Record. Attest.

City Clerk

- Meeting End Time: 8:32PM
- Minutes Prepared By: Michael Intranuovo
